name: Unlucky Collapsing Tunnel
disable: DC 18 Nature check check to counteract the aura of unluck that pervades the tunnels for 1 minute, or DC 20 Survival check to support the tunnel ceiling properly without triggering a collapse

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the tunnel

---
Effect The tunnel falls in, dealing 2d10 untyped damage to each creature in the area (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). Creatures in the area must spend at least 5 minutes digging themselves out to continue (DC 20 Survival check halves this time).

text: At the unluckiest time, the shoddily supported tunnel wall collapses in on itself and floods the tunnel with dirt and stone.
